name: City of Winooski Summer Camps (Thrive Summer Camps and Recreation & Parks Summer Camps)
description_short: The City of Winooski ran two sets of themed weekly summer camps in 2026, Thrive Summer Camps and Recreation & Parks Summer Camps. Both were for children who had finished kindergarten through 5th grade in the 2025-26 school year.

Source is an archived City of Winooski news post (published 2/3/2026, archived 6/30/2026), not the camp's own program page. It describes the 2026 season, which is over as of today (2026-10-13). No 2027 information.

The post covers two separate programs with different contacts. Thrive Summer Camps: 802 540 1533, thrive@winooskivt.gov. Recreation & Parks Summer Camps: 802 540 1476, recreation@winooskivt.gov. They are combined here, and session names are prefixed with the program name.

Thrive is described as 'completed grades K-5' and Recreation & Parks as 'current Kindergarteners through current 5th graders (school year 2025-26)'. Both describe the same grade group, recorded here as K (0) through 5.
Financial aid differs by program: Thrive has a state subsidy for eligible families, and Recreation & Parks has a scholarship option at checkout.
The City Hall address on the page (27 West Allen Street, Winooski, VT 05404) is not necessarily where the camps meet, so it was not recorded as the camp address.
